result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major layout problem where the bottom navigation is obscured by an overlapping black bar.

issues.description: A thick black horizontal bar overlaps the bottom navigation bar, obscuring the middle Search and Orders icons and making them difficult to see and tap.
issues.suggestion: Move the system home indicator into the proper bottom safe-area inset below the navigation bar, and ensure the navigation icons are not covered by any overlay.
